server.metadata.openSubtitlesDownloadsOf.source: {remaining} of {allowed, plural, one {# download} other {# downloads}} left today

server.metadata.openSubtitlesKeyRejected.text: OpenSubtitles accepterede ikke API-nøglen. Kontrollér den, gem, og test igen.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesKeyRejected.source: OpenSubtitles didn’t accept the API key. Check it, save, and test again.

server.metadata.openSubtitlesKeyWorks.text: Nøglen virker. Tilføj også din konto, så Portico kan downloade.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesKeyWorks.source: The key works. Add your account too, so Portico can download.

server.metadata.openSubtitlesLater.text: OpenSubtitles bad Portico om at vente. Prøv igen senere.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesLater.source: OpenSubtitles asked Portico to wait. Try again later.

server.metadata.openSubtitlesNeedsAccoun.text: Søgning virker, men OpenSubtitles tillader kun download fra konti, der er logget ind. Tilføj dit brugernavn og din adgangskode.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesNeedsAccoun.source: Searching works, but OpenSubtitles only lets signed-in accounts download. Add your username and password.

server.metadata.openSubtitlesNoPassword.text: Tilføj kontoens adgangskode for at logge ind.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesNoPassword.source: Add the account’s password to sign in.

server.metadata.openSubtitlesNotSetUp.text: Ikke sat op. Tilføj din OpenSubtitles-API-nøgle for at søge efter undertekster.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesNotSetUp.source: Not set up. Add your OpenSubtitles API key to search for subtitles.

server.metadata.openSubtitlesQuotaUsed.text: Dagens downloads er brugt op. De starter igen kl. {time}.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesQuotaUsed.source: Today’s downloads are used up. They start again at {time}.

server.metadata.openSubtitlesSlowDown.text: OpenSubtitles bad Portico om at vente til {time}.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesSlowDown.source: OpenSubtitles asked Portico to wait until {time}.

server.metadata.openSubtitlesTestUnsaved.text: Gem dine ændringer, og test dem derefter.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesTestUnsaved.source: Save your changes, then test them.

server.metadata.openSubtitlesUnreachable.text: OpenSubtitles kunne ikke nås. Test igen om lidt.
server.metadata.openSubtitlesUnreachable.source: OpenSubtitles couldn’t be reached. Test again in a little while.

server.metadata.perLibraryHelp.text: Hvert bibliotek vælger sin egen: TMDB, en anden udbyder eller kun lokale metadata. Åbn et bibliotek, og vælg Metadata.
server.metadata.perLibraryHelp.source: Each library chooses its own: TMDB, another provider, or local metadata only. Open a library and choose Metadata.

server.metadata.subtitlesLede.text: Portico søger efter undertekster hos OpenSubtitles.com med din egen gratis konto og API-nøgle. Opret en konto på opensubtitles.com, og tilføj derefter en API-forbruger i din profil der for at få en nøgle.
server.metadata.subtitlesLede.source: Portico searches OpenSubtitles.com with your own free account and API key. Create an account at opensubtitles.com, then add an API consumer in your profile there to get a key.

server.missing.removeBody.text: Dette fjerner {count, plural, one {# titel} other {# titler}} fra biblioteket. Intet på disken berøres, og seerhistorik bevares, hvis de kommer tilbage.
server.missing.removeBody.source: This removes {count, plural, one {# title} other {# titles}} from the library. Nothing on disk is touched, and watch history is kept in case they come back.

server.ownCert.keptPrevious.text: {problem} Det certifikat, der virkede før, er stadig i brug.
server.ownCert.keptPrevious.source: {problem} The certificate that worked before is still in use.

server.ownCert.problem.source: The certificate files can’t be used.

server.people.blockBody.text: Den logges ud med det samme og kan ikke bruge denne server, før du godkender den igen.
server.people.blockBody.source: It is signed out at once and can’t use this server until you approve it again.

server.people.deleteBody.text: Dette fjerner {name}s konto, {profiles, plural, one {# profil} other {# profiler}} og alt, de profiler gemte: seerfremskridt, historik, lister og spillelister. {devices, plural, one {# enhed logges} other {# enheder logges}} ud. Intet i dine biblioteker slettes, og optagelser bevares.
server.people.deleteBody.source: This removes {name}’s account, {profiles, plural, one {# profile} other {# profiles}} and everything those profiles saved: watch progress, history, lists and playlists. {devices, plural, one {# device is} other {# devices are}} signed out. Nothing in your libraries is deleted, and recordings are kept.

server.people.deleteChanged.text: Denne persons konto ændrede sig, mens du kiggede. Kontrollér den igen, før du sletter.
server.people.deleteChanged.source: This person’s account changed while you were looking. Check it again before deleting.

server.people.deleteHelp.text: Fjerner dem fra denne server for altid. For at stoppe nogen i at logge ind uden at fjerne dem, skal du i stedet slå deres konto fra.
server.people.deleteHelp.source: Removes them from this server for good. To stop someone signing in without removing them, turn their account off instead.

server.people.deleteHistoryKept.text: {count, plural, one {# afspilning bliver i din afspilningshistorik uden deres navn.} other {# afspilninger bliver i din afspilningshistorik uden deres navn.}}
server.people.deleteHistoryKept.source: {count, plural, one {# play stays in your play history, without their name.} other {# plays stay in your play history, without their name.}}

server.people.deletePorticoAccount.text: Deres Portico Account slettes ikke. Den holder bare op med at være medlem af denne server.
server.people.deletePorticoAccount.source: Their Portico Account is not deleted. It just stops being a member of this server.

server.people.deviceApproval.text: Nye enheder venter på din godkendelse
server.people.deviceApproval.source: New devices wait for your approval

server.people.deviceApprovalHelp.text: En enhed, der logger ind første gang, kan ikke gennemse eller afspille, før du godkender den her. Allerede godkendte enheder er ikke berørte.
server.people.deviceApprovalHelp.source: A device signing in for the first time can’t browse or play until you approve it here. Devices already approved are not affected.

server.people.hoursLede.text: Hvornår denne person kan logge ind og se. Uden angivne timer, når som helst.
server.people.hoursLede.source: When this person can sign in and watch. With no hours set, any time.

server.people.hoursTimeHelp.source: Type a time, such as 8:30 or 20:15.

server.people.inviteCode.source: Or give them the code on its own: {code}

server.people.inviteRecipientHelp.text: Nævn én Portico Account, så kun den konto kan bruge invitationen. Lad stå tom, så kan alle med linket.
server.people.inviteRecipientHelp.source: Name one Portico Account and only that account can use the invitation. Leave empty and anyone with the link can.

server.people.libraryGone.text: Et bibliotek, der ikke længere er her
server.people.libraryGone.source: A library that is no longer here

server.people.passwordWeak.text: Vælg en længere eller mindre almindelig adgangskode.
server.people.passwordWeak.source: Choose a longer or less common password.

server.people.revokeInvitationBody.text: Linket og koden holder op med at virke med det samme.
server.people.revokeInvitationBody.source: The link and the code stop working at once.

server.people.signInHelp.text: Sæt en ny adgangskode, eller slå kontoen fra uden at fjerne den.
server.people.signInHelp.source: Set a new password, or turn the account off without removing it.

server.places.deleteCopyBody.text: Den skal kun bruges til at gå tilbage til versionen før opgraderingen. Det kan ikke fortrydes.
server.places.deleteCopyBody.source: It is only needed to go back to the version before the upgrade. This cannot be undone.

server.places.lede.text: Disse mapper vælges, når serveren starter. For at ændre én, se installationsvejledningen.
server.places.lede.source: These folders are chosen when the server starts. To change one, see the installation guide.

server.places.reclaim.source: Space the database can give back

server.places.reclaimHelp.text: Portico giver den tilbage til disken af sig selv, lidt ad gangen.
server.places.reclaimHelp.source: Portico gives it back to the disk by itself, a little at a time.

server.places.upgradeCopiesNone.text: Ingen. Portico gemmer en kopi af databasen, før den ændrer den til en ny version.
server.places.upgradeCopiesNone.source: None. Portico keeps a copy of the database before it changes it for a new version.

server.plays.empty.text: Intet er blevet afspillet på denne server endnu.
server.plays.empty.source: Nothing has been played on this server yet.

server.reports.deleteBody.text: Rapporten fjernes fra denne server. Det kan ikke fortrydes.
server.reports.deleteBody.source: The report is removed from this server. This cannot be undone.

server.reports.lede.text: Logs, en app sendte, efter noget gik galt. De kan nævne titler og enheder, så slet dem, når du er færdig.
server.reports.lede.source: Logs an app sent after something went wrong. They can name titles and devices, so delete them when you are done.

server.restart.body.text: Alt, der afspiller, stopper, og apps opretter selv forbindelse igen, når serveren er tilbage, normalt inden for et minut.
server.restart.body.source: Anything playing stops, and apps reconnect by themselves once the server is back, usually within a minute.

server.restart.failed.text: Serveren kunne ikke genstartes. Prøv igen.
server.restart.failed.source: The server could not be restarted. Try again.

server.restart.waiting.text: Venter på, at serveren kommer tilbage
server.restart.waiting.source: Waiting for the server to come back

server.routes.forgetFor.source: Forget the playback problems of this file

server.routes.forgotten.text: Glemt. Portico prøver den vej igen.
server.routes.forgotten.source: Forgotten. Portico will try that way again.

server.routes.lede.text: Når en enhed ikke kan afspille en fil på én måde, afspiller Portico den i stedet på en anden måde i et stykke tid frem for at fejle igen. Glem én for at lade den første måde blive prøvet.
server.routes.lede.source: When a device can’t play a file one way, Portico plays it another way for a while instead of failing again. Forget one to let the first way be tried.

server.routes.route.copy_remux.text: Ompakker filen uden at konvertere den
server.routes.route.copy_remux.source: Repackaging the file without converting it

server.routes.unknownTitle.text: En fil, der ikke længere er i et bibliotek
server.routes.unknownTitle.source: A file no longer in a library

server.scan.depthHelp.basic.text: Læs fildetaljer (længde, opløsning, lyd) og lokal grafik.
server.scan.depthHelp.basic.source: Read file details (length, resolution, audio) and local artwork.

server.scan.depthHelp.complete.text: Alt, inklusive forhåndsvisninger, lydstyrke og fingeraftryk.
server.scan.depthHelp.complete.source: Everything, including previews, loudness and fingerprints.

server.scan.depthHelp.custom.text: Vælg præcis, hvilke trin der kører.

server.scan.depthHelp.file_list_only.text: Find blot filer. Ingen fildetaljer eller grafik.
server.scan.depthHelp.file_list_only.source: Just find files. No file details or artwork.

server.scan.skipped.text: Hvad den seneste scanning sprang over

server.scan.skippedHelp.text: Filer og mapper, scanningen udelod, hver med hvorfor. Alt andet blev scannet som normalt.
server.scan.skippedHelp.source: Files and folders the scan left out, each with why. Everything else was scanned as usual.

server.setAside.lede.text: Portico kunne ikke afslutte disse titler, så den lagde dem til side og fortsatte med resten. Den prøver dem igen af sig selv.
server.setAside.lede.source: Portico could not finish working out these titles, so it set them aside and carried on with the rest. It tries them again by itself.

server.setAside.more.text: Flere er lagt til side, end der vises her.
server.setAside.more.source: More are set aside than are listed here.

server.setAside.tried.text: {count, plural, one {Prøvet # gang} other {Prøvet # gange}}, sidst {when}.
server.setAside.tried.source: {count, plural, one {Tried # time} other {Tried # times}}, last on {when}.

server.startup.instance.text: Stop den anden Portico-tjeneste, der bruger denne tilstandsmappe, og genstart derefter denne tjeneste.
server.startup.instance.source: Stop the other Portico service using this state folder, then restart this service.

server.startup.permissions.text: Giv tjenestekontoen tilladelse til at læse og skrive tilstandsmappe, og genstart derefter Portico.
server.startup.permissions.source: Give the service account permission to read and write the state folder, then restart Portico.

server.startup.phase.text: Serveren kunne ikke afslutte sine startkontroller.
server.startup.phase.source: The server could not finish its startup checks.

server.startup.recovery.text: Kontrollér tjenestens log for detaljer. Ret årsagen, og genstart derefter Portico. Dine filer er ikke blevet fjernet.
server.startup.recovery.source: Check the service log for details. Fix the cause, then restart Portico. Your files have not been removed.

server.startup.space.text: Frigør plads på drevet med tilstandsmappe, og genstart derefter Portico.
server.startup.space.source: Free space on the drive holding the state folder, then restart Portico.

server.startup.storage.text: Kontrollér, at tilstandsmappe er tilgængelig, har ledig plads og kan læses og skrives af tjenesten.
server.startup.storage.source: Check that the state folder is available, has free space, and can be read and written by the service.

server.startup.version.text: Denne database matcher ikke denne Portico-version. Gem en kopi af tilstandsmappe, og gendan derefter en sikkerhedskopi lavet med denne version, eller start med en ny tilstandsmappe.
server.startup.version.source: This database does not match this Portico version. Keep a copy of the state folder, then restore a backup made with this version or start with a new state folder.

server.storage.category.artwork.descript.text: Plakater, baggrunde og miniaturer, som serveren har hentet, udtrukket eller fået.
server.storage.category.artwork.descript.source: Posters, backdrops and thumbnails the server has fetched, extracted or been given.

server.storage.category.conversions.desc.text: Segmenter, der blev skrevet, mens en stream blev konverteret. Sikkert at fjerne, når intet afspilles.
server.storage.category.conversions.desc.source: Segments written while a stream was being converted. Safe to remove when nothing is playing.

server.storage.category.downloads.descri.text: Pakker, der er klargjort, så en klient kan tage dem offline.
server.storage.category.downloads.descri.source: Packages staged for a client to take offline.

server.storage.category.prepared-media.d.text: Optimerede versioner, der er forberedt til download, eller til en enhed der ikke kan afspille originalen.
server.storage.category.prepared-media.d.source: Optimised versions prepared for download or for a device that cannot play the original.

server.storage.category.recordings.descr.text: Optagede optagelser. Det er indhold, og vedligeholdelsessiden fjerner dem aldrig.
server.storage.category.recordings.descr.source: Captured recordings. These are content: the maintenance page never removes them.

server.storage.category.subtitles.descri.source: Extracted, downloaded and rendered subtitle tracks.

server.storage.category.trickplay.descri.text: Spolefliser, der laves for hver fil. Det er normalt den største kategori, som kan genskabes.
server.storage.category.trickplay.descri.source: Scrubbing tiles generated per file. This is usually the largest regenerable category.

server.updates.checkHelp.text: Serveren leder efter en nyere version og fortæller dig her. Portico installerer aldrig selv en opdatering.
server.updates.checkHelp.source: The server looks for a newer version and tells you here. Portico never installs an update by itself.

server.usage.connectionsHelp.text: Yderligere {reserve} holdes altid til denne konsol og til login.
server.usage.connectionsHelp.source: Another {reserve} are always kept for this console and for signing in.

server.usage.lede.text: Hvad serveren bruger i øjeblikket, ved siden af de grænser, du kan sætte.
server.usage.lede.source: What the server is using at the moment, beside the limits you can set.

servers.connectDirect.text: Log direkte ind på en server
servers.connectDirect.source: Sign in directly to a server

settings.help.audioLanguages.text: Portico vælger den første af disse, en titel har. Uden valgte afspilles titlens originale spor.
settings.help.audioLanguages.source: Portico picks the first of these a title has. With none chosen, it plays the title’s original track.

settings.help.backdrops.source: Artwork behind title pages and Home.

settings.help.disableHdr.text: Slå til, hvis HDR-titler ser grå, udvaskede eller for mørke ud.
settings.help.disableHdr.source: Turn this on if HDR titles look grey, washed out or too dark.

settings.help.disablePassthrough.text: Slå til, hvis Dolby- eller DTS-titler afspiller uden lyd.
settings.help.disablePassthrough.source: Turn this on if Dolby or DTS titles play without sound.

settings.help.forceStereo.text: Slå til, hvis surroundlyd er stille, eller stemmer mangler.
settings.help.forceStereo.source: Turn this on if surround sound is silent or voices are missing.

settings.help.gapless.text: Ingen stilhed mellem sange, der løber ind i hinanden.
settings.help.gapless.source: No silence between songs that run into each other.

settings.help.layout.text: Fjernsyn: fjernbetjeningsfokus og stor skrift. Berøring: telefon- og tabletskærme. Portico genstarter for at skifte.
settings.help.layout.source: Television: remote-control focus and large type. Touch: phone and tablet screens. Portico restarts to change it.

settings.help.libraryView.text: Et bibliotek, du har skiftet, beholder sin egen visning.
settings.help.libraryView.source: A library you have switched keeps its own view.

settings.help.lyrics.text: Følg med i takt med sangen, når den har sangtekster.
settings.help.lyrics.source: Follow along in time with the song when it has lyrics.

settings.help.playbackMethod.text: Automatisk afspiller den originale fil, når denne enhed kan, og konverterer den, når den ikke kan.
settings.help.playbackMethod.source: Automatic plays the original file when this device can, and converts it when it can’t.

settings.help.player.text: Automatisk bruger denne enheds egen afspiller, når den kan afspille en titel, som den er, og mpv, når titlen ellers skulle konverteres eller have sine undertekster brændt ind.
settings.help.player.source: Automatic uses this device’s own player when it can play a title as it is, and mpv when the title would otherwise have to be converted or have its subtitles burned in.

settings.help.qualityAway.text: På ethvert andet netværk. Automatisk starter med originalen, sænker kun kvaliteten, mens din forbindelse kræver det, og hæver den igen, når den kan.
settings.help.qualityAway.source: On any other network. Automatic starts with the original, lowers the quality only while your connection needs it, and raises it again when it can.

settings.help.qualityHome.text: Når denne enhed er på din servers hjemmenetværk. Original afspiller hver fil, som den er; Automatisk starter der og tilpasser sig din forbindelse. Du kan vælge en anden kvalitet til én visning i afspilleren.
settings.help.qualityHome.source: When this device is on your server’s home network. Original plays every file as it is; Automatic starts there and adjusts to your connection. You can pick another quality for one viewing in the player.

settings.help.receiveFromDevices.text: Lader din telefon eller computer starte afspilning på dette TV.
settings.help.receiveFromDevices.source: Lets your phone or computer start playback on this TV.

settings.help.reduceMotionDevice.text: Kortere overgange. Portico følger også denne enheds indstilling for Reducer bevægelse.
settings.help.reduceMotionDevice.source: Shorter transitions. Portico also follows the Reduce Motion setting of this device.

settings.help.showActivity.text: Lader andre på denne server se, hvad du ser, og tæller det med i ”Populært på denne server”.
settings.help.showActivity.source: Lets others on this server see what you’re watching, and counts it in “Popular on this server”.

settings.help.stillWatching.text: Sætter på pause efter flere episoder i træk, hvor ingen har rørt kontrollerne.
settings.help.stillWatching.source: Pauses after several episodes in a row when no one has touched the controls.

settings.help.subtitleLanguages.text: Portico vælger den første af disse, en titel har.
settings.help.subtitleLanguages.source: Portico picks the first of these a title has.

settings.help.subtitleMode.text: Tvungne undertekster oversætter kun de linjer, der tales på et andet sprog.
settings.help.subtitleMode.source: Forced subtitles translate only the lines spoken in another language.

settings.help.tvHdr.text: Slå til, hvis dit TV viser HDR. HDR-titler sendes da, som de er, i stedet for at blive konverteret til standardområde.
settings.help.tvHdr.source: Turn on if your TV shows HDR. HDR titles are then sent as they are instead of being converted to standard range.

settings.help.tvSurround.text: Slå til, hvis dit TV eller et lydsystem tilsluttet det afspiller 5.1- eller 7.1-lyd. Surround bevares da i stedet for at blive mikset ned til stereo.
settings.help.tvSurround.source: Turn on if your TV, or a sound system connected to it, plays 5.1 or 7.1 sound. Surround is then kept instead of being mixed down to stereo.

settings.help.volumeLeveling.text: Afspiller sange eller album med ensartet lydstyrke.
settings.help.volumeLeveling.source: Plays songs or albums at a similar loudness.

settings.layout.restart.text: Portico genstarter for at bruge det nye layout.
settings.layout.restart.source: Portico restarts to use the new layout.

settings.linkTVHelp.text: Log et TV ind med den kode, det viser
settings.linkTVHelp.source: Sign a TV in with the code it shows

settings.notSaved.text: Den ændring blev ikke gemt. Prøv igen.
settings.notSaved.source: That change wasn’t saved. Try again.

settings.openOnWeb.text: Scan koden med din telefon, eller gå til {url} på en computer.
settings.openOnWeb.source: Scan the code with your phone, or go to {url} on a computer.

settings.resetRecommendations.confirmBod.text: Portico vil glemme, hvad det har lært om din smag. Din seerhistorik, dine vurderinger og lister bevares.
settings.resetRecommendations.confirmBod.source: Portico will forget what it has learned about your taste. Your watch history, ratings and lists stay.

settings.resetRecommendations.failed.text: Anbefalinger kunne ikke nulstilles. Prøv igen.
settings.resetRecommendations.failed.source: Recommendations couldn’t be reset. Try again.

settings.resetRecommendations.help.text: Start forfra med det, Portico anbefaler dig.
settings.resetRecommendations.help.source: Start over with what Portico recommends to you.

settings.row.disablePassthrough.text: Send ikke lyd uberørt til min receiver
settings.row.disablePassthrough.source: Don’t send sound to my receiver untouched

settings.row.startNextDuringCredits.source: Start the next episode during the credits

settings.row.unreadBadge.text: Vis en prik for nye notifikationer
settings.row.unreadBadge.source: Show a dot for new notifications

settings.save.afterRestart.text: Træder i kraft, når serveren genstarter
settings.save.afterRestart.source: Takes effect after the server restarts

settings.section.playbackFixes.text: Hvis noget ser forkert ud eller lyder forkert
settings.section.playbackFixes.source: If something looks or sounds wrong

settings.section.playbackFixesHelp.text: Lad disse være slukket, medmindre en titel afspiller dårligt på denne enhed.
settings.section.playbackFixesHelp.source: Leave these off unless a title plays badly on this device.

settings.section.tvOutputs.text: Hvad dette TV kan vise og afspille
settings.section.tvOutputs.source: What this TV can show and play

settings.section.tvOutputsHelp.text: Denne enhed kan ikke se, hvad dit TV og lydsystem understøtter, så Portico afspiller alt i standardområde og stereo, indtil du siger andet.
settings.section.tvOutputsHelp.source: This device can’t tell what your TV and sound system support, so Portico plays everything in standard range and stereo until you say otherwise.

settings.server.accountCapHelp.text: Gælder for hver konto. En persons egen grænse sættes på deres konto i Personer.
settings.server.accountCapHelp.source: Applies to each account. A person’s own limit is set on their account in People.

settings.server.advertiseUrlHelp.text: Adressen, folk uden for dit hjem bruger til at nå denne server, f.eks. https://media.example.com. Brug et værtsnavn uden sti efter.
settings.server.advertiseUrlHelp.source: The address people outside your home use to reach this server, such as https://media.example.com. Use a hostname with no path after it.

settings.server.allowConverting.text: Konvertér video, en enhed ikke kan afspille
settings.server.allowConverting.source: Convert video a device can’t play

settings.server.apiRate.text: Anmodninger, hver nøgle eller token må lave
settings.server.apiRate.source: Requests each key or token may make

settings.server.apiRateHelp.text: En nøgle eller et token, der spørger oftere end dette, bedes vente. Folk, der bruger appsene, sænkes aldrig af det. Lad stå tom for de sædvanlige 600 i minuttet.
settings.server.apiRateHelp.source: A key or token that asks more often than this is told to wait. People using the apps are never slowed by it. Leave empty for the usual 600 a minute.

settings.server.backgroundPausedUntil.text: Baggrundsarbejde er sat på pause indtil {time}.

settings.server.backgroundSpeedHelp.text: Hvor hårdt Portico arbejder med scanning, matching, analyse, grafik og vedligeholdelse. Skånsom passer til en lille server. Hurtig afslutter en stor import før. Afspilning kommer altid først.
settings.server.backgroundSpeedHelp.source: How hard Portico works at scanning, matching, analysis, artwork and maintenance. Gentle suits a small server. Fast finishes a large import sooner. Playback always comes first.

settings.server.connectionLimitHelp.text: Flest forbindelser, serveren accepterer på én gang. Lad stå tom, så vælger serveren ud fra sin hukommelse. Konsollen og login beholder altid plads til sig selv. En ændring træder i kraft, når serveren genstarter.
settings.server.connectionLimitHelp.source: The most connections the server accepts at once. Leave empty and the server chooses from its memory. The console and sign-in always keep room of their own. A change takes effect after the server restarts.

settings.server.conversionsBackgroundHel.text: Konverteringer, ingen ser. De tager aldrig en plads fra en, der ser med.
settings.server.conversionsBackgroundHel.source: Conversions nobody is watching. They never take a slot from someone who is.

settings.server.conversionsHelp.text: Yderligere streams, der skal konverteres, venter eller afspiller i lavere kvalitet.
settings.server.conversionsHelp.source: Further streams that need converting wait or play at a lower quality.

settings.server.detailWindow.help.text: Slår detaljerede beskeder til og slår sig selv fra igen.
settings.server.detailWindow.help.source: Turns on detailed messages, then turns itself off.

settings.server.discoveryHelp.text: Lader apps på dit netværk finde serveren uden at skrive en adresse.
settings.server.discoveryHelp.source: Lets apps on your network find the server without typing an address.

settings.server.dlnaHelp.text: Lader tv, konsoller og andre DLNA-enheder på dit hjemmenetværk gennemse og afspille alt på denne server uden at logge ind.
settings.server.dlnaHelp.source: Lets TVs, consoles and other DLNA devices on your home network browse and play everything on this server, without signing in.

settings.server.encoderSpeedHelp.text: Hurtigere bruger mindre processor og giver et lidt blødere billede ved samme størrelse.
settings.server.encoderSpeedHelp.source: Faster uses less processor and gives a slightly softer picture at the same size.

settings.server.extraAddressesHelp.text: Flere adresser, apps kan prøve, f.eks. et VPN-navn. Apps tester selv hver enkelt.
settings.server.extraAddressesHelp.source: More addresses apps may try, such as a VPN name. Apps test each one themselves.

settings.server.ffmpegChosenHelp.text: Lad stå tom for at bruge den FFmpeg, der følger med Portico. For at bruge en anden build skal du angive dens fulde sti. Portico kontrollerer den, når du gemmer, og tager den i brug, når serveren genstarter.
settings.server.ffmpegChosenHelp.source: Leave empty to use the FFmpeg that comes with Portico. To use another build, give its full path. Portico checks it when you save and starts using it after the server restarts.

settings.server.hardwareDeviceHelp.text: Lad stå tom for at lade serveren vælge. På Linux en render-enhedssti.
settings.server.hardwareDeviceHelp.source: Leave empty to let the server choose. On Linux, a render device path.

settings.server.hardwareHelp.text: Automatisk bruger den grafikhardware, denne server har, og falder tilbage til processoren.
settings.server.hardwareHelp.source: Automatic uses the graphics hardware this server has, and falls back to the processor.

settings.server.homeNetworkLede.text: Disse netværk afgør, hvad der tæller som hjemme. En enhed alle andre steder er uden for hjemmet, og reglerne og grænserne for uden for hjemmet gælder for den.
settings.server.homeNetworkLede.source: These networks decide what counts as home. A device anywhere else is away from home, and the away-from-home rules and limits apply to it.

settings.server.homeNetworksHelp.text: En adresse eller et interval, f.eks. 192.168.2.0/24. Listen starter med de sædvanlige private intervaller og de netværk, denne server er tilsluttet. Tilføj et VPN-interval, hvis det skal tælle som hjemme. Med en tom liste er alle enheder uden for hjemmet.
settings.server.homeNetworksHelp.source: An address or a range, such as 192.168.2.0/24. The list starts with the usual private ranges and the networks this server is attached to. Add a VPN range if it should count as home. With an empty list, every device is away from home.

settings.server.jobs.never.text: Ikke planlagt: intet aktiveret vindue indeholder det
settings.server.jobs.never.source: Not scheduled: no enabled window includes it

settings.server.memberTokensMay.text: Medlemmer må lave deres egne tokens
settings.server.memberTokensMay.source: Members may make their own tokens

settings.server.memberTokensMayHelp.text: Hvis du vælger Nej, stopper nye tokens. Tokens, der allerede findes, bliver ved med at virke, indtil du afslutter dem.
settings.server.memberTokensMayHelp.source: Choosing No stops new tokens. Tokens that already exist keep working until you end them.

settings.server.missingTitlesLede.text: En titel, hvis filer ikke længere er på disken, bliver i biblioteket markeret som manglende. Hvis filerne kommer tilbage, gør titlen det også med alt, som det var.
settings.server.missingTitlesLede.source: A title whose files are no longer on disk stays in the library, marked missing. If the files come back, so does the title, with everything as it was.

settings.server.missingTitlesRuleHelp.text: Seerhistorik bevares under alle omstændigheder og vender tilbage, hvis en titel tilføjes igen.
settings.server.missingTitlesRuleHelp.source: Watch history is kept either way, and returns if a title is added again.

settings.server.ownCertificateLede.text: Til dit eget domæne uden reverse proxy: certifikat- og nøglefilerne på denne server i PEM-form og det domæne, de dækker. Serveren opdager selv fornyede filer.
settings.server.ownCertificateLede.source: For your own domain without a reverse proxy: the certificate and key files on this server, in PEM form, and the domain they cover. The server picks up renewed files by itself.

settings.server.pauseBackground.text: Sæt baggrundsarbejde på pause i en time
settings.server.pauseBackground.source: Pause background work for an hour

settings.server.planning.text: Når en enhed ikke kan afspille en fil
settings.server.planning.source: When a device can’t play a file

settings.server.planning.maximum_compati.text: Afspil på så mange enheder som muligt
settings.server.planning.maximum_compati.source: Play on as many devices as possible

settings.server.planning.minimize_server.source: Do the least work on the server

settings.server.planningHelp.text: Hvad serveren foretrækker, når den vælger, hvordan en titel leveres.
settings.server.planningHelp.source: What the server favors when it chooses how to deliver a title.

settings.server.playHistoryKeepHelp.text: Alle afspilninger bevares, medmindre du angiver et antal dage. Afspilningstal bevares under alle omstændigheder.
settings.server.playHistoryKeepHelp.source: Every play is kept unless you set a number of days. Play counts are kept either way.

settings.server.qualityLimitHelp.text: Højeste bitrate for alle uden for dit hjemmenetværk.
settings.server.qualityLimitHelp.source: Highest bitrate for anyone outside your home network.

settings.server.remote.notSetUp.text: Fjernadgang er ikke sat op på denne server.
settings.server.remote.notSetUp.source: Remote access is not set up on this server.

settings.server.remote.off.text: Fjernadgang er slået fra. Enheder på dit hjemmenetværk opretter forbindelse som normalt.
settings.server.remote.off.source: Remote access is off. Devices on your home network connect as usual.

settings.server.repackage.text: Ompak i stedet for at konvertere, når det er nok
settings.server.repackage.source: Repackage instead of converting when that is enough

settings.server.repackageHelp.text: Skifter kun filens container og beholder billede og lyd, som de er.
settings.server.repackageHelp.source: Changes only the file’s container and keeps the picture and sound as they are.

settings.server.retentionLede.text: Hvor længe registreringer, genererede filer og sikkerhedskopier bliver, før serveren fjerner dem.
settings.server.retentionLede.source: How long records, generated files and backups stay before the server removes them.

settings.server.secure.connectHelp.text: Åbner din Portico Account i et nyt vindue, hvor du godkender denne server. Det er alt: certifikatet følger af sig selv.
settings.server.secure.connectHelp.source: Opens your Portico Account in a new window, where you approve this server. That’s all: the certificate follows by itself.

settings.server.secure.connectInBrowserH.text: Åbner denne servers indstillinger i din browser, hvor du godkender den i din Portico Account. Eller log ind på din Portico Account i denne app for at gøre det her.
settings.server.secure.connectInBrowserH.source: Opens this server’s settings in your browser, where you approve it in your Portico Account. Or sign in to your Portico Account in this app to do it here.

settings.server.secure.connectWithAccoun.text: Forbinder denne server til din Portico Account og henter dens certifikat. Intet andet at gøre.
settings.server.secure.connectWithAccoun.source: Connects this server to your Portico Account and gets its certificate. Nothing else to do.

settings.server.secure.connected.source: Connected. Portico is getting the certificate now.

settings.server.secure.lede.text: Krypterer alt mellem dine enheder og denne server, hjemme og ude, med et certifikat, hver browser og app stoler på. Portico skaffer og fornyer det for dig.
settings.server.secure.lede.source: Encrypts everything between your devices and this server, at home and away, with a certificate every browser and app trusts. Portico gets it and renews it for you.

settings.server.secure.notSetUp.text: Enheder opretter forbindelse med almindelig HTTP. For at slå en sikker forbindelse til skal du forbinde denne server til din Portico Account: Portico skaffer og fornyer derefter selv et certifikat. Eller brug dit eget certifikat nedenfor.
settings.server.secure.notSetUp.source: Devices connect with plain HTTP. To turn on a secure connection, connect this server to your Portico Account: Portico then gets and renews a certificate by itself. Or use your own certificate, below.

settings.server.secure.notSetUpOwnOnly.text: Enheder opretter forbindelse med almindelig HTTP. For at slå en sikker forbindelse til skal du bruge dit eget certifikat nedenfor.
settings.server.secure.notSetUpOwnOnly.source: Devices connect with plain HTTP. To turn on a secure connection, use your own certificate, below.

settings.server.secure.off.text: Enheder opretter forbindelse med almindelig HTTP. Slå ”Brug en sikker forbindelse” til for at kryptere deres forbindelse igen.
settings.server.secure.off.source: Devices connect with plain HTTP. Turn on “Use a secure connection” to encrypt their connection again.

settings.server.secure.on.text: Enheder opretter sikkert forbindelse til denne server, hjemme og ude.
settings.server.secure.on.source: Devices connect to this server securely, at home and away.

settings.server.secure.onAt.text: Enheder opretter sikkert forbindelse til denne server, hjemme og ude. Dens sikre adresse er {address}.
settings.server.secure.onAt.source: Devices connect to this server securely, at home and away. Its secure address is {address}.

settings.server.secure.own.text: Enheder opretter sikker forbindelse med dit eget certifikat.
settings.server.secure.own.source: Devices connect securely with your own certificate.

settings.server.secure.ownAt.text: Enheder opretter sikker forbindelse til {address} med dit eget certifikat.
settings.server.secure.ownAt.source: Devices connect securely to {address} with your own certificate.

settings.server.secure.portHelp.text: Porten, enheder bruger til den sikre adresse uden for hjemmet.
settings.server.secure.portHelp.source: The port devices use for the secure address from outside your home.

settings.server.secure.starting.text: Portico skaffer et certifikat til denne server. Det tager normalt et minut eller to; der er intet at gøre imens.
settings.server.secure.starting.source: Portico is getting a certificate for this server. This usually takes a minute or two; nothing needs doing meanwhile.

settings.server.secure.toggleHelp.text: Når dette er slået fra, opretter enheder forbindelse med almindelig HTTP. De virker stadig; deres forbindelse er bare ikke krypteret.
settings.server.secure.toggleHelp.source: When this is off, devices connect with plain HTTP. They still work; their connection just isn’t encrypted.

settings.server.secure.waiting.text: Godkend denne server i din Portico Account for at afslutte. Certifikatet følger af sig selv.
settings.server.secure.waiting.source: Approve this server in your Portico Account to finish. The certificate follows by itself.

settings.server.sessionSpaceHelp.text: Hvor meget disk en stream, der konverteres, må bruge til sine arbejdsfiler. Når det nås, fjernes først de dele, der allerede er afspillet.
settings.server.sessionSpaceHelp.source: How much disk a stream being converted may use for its working files. When it is reached, the parts already played are removed first.

settings.server.skippedParts.text: Dele, denne app ikke kunne læse
settings.server.skippedParts.source: Parts this app could not read

settings.server.skippedPartsCount.source: {count, plural, one {# left out} other {# left out}}

settings.server.skippedPartsLede.text: Når serveren sender noget, denne app ikke forstår, normalt fordi serveren er nyere, udelader appen den del og viser resten. Dette viser, hvad der blev udeladt på denne enhed, siden appen startede.
settings.server.skippedPartsLede.source: When the server sends something this app does not understand, usually because the server is newer, the app leaves that part out and shows the rest. This lists what was left out on this device since the app started.

settings.server.tempFolderHelp.text: Hvor serveren skriver video, mens den konverterer den. Lad stå tom for dens egen cachemappe.
settings.server.tempFolderHelp.source: Where the server writes video while converting it. Leave empty for its own cache folder.

settings.server.toneMappingHelp.text: Bevarer farverne, når HDR-video konverteres til en skærm uden HDR.
settings.server.toneMappingHelp.source: Keeps colors right when HDR video is converted for a screen without HDR.

settings.server.trustedProxiesHelp.text: Adressen på en reverse proxy foran denne server, f.eks. 127.0.0.1. Serveren stoler på den seeradresse, en listet proxy sender videre. Lad stå tom, hvis du ikke bruger én.
settings.server.trustedProxiesHelp.source: The address of a reverse proxy in front of this server, such as 127.0.0.1. The server believes the viewer address a listed proxy passes on. Leave empty if you don’t use one.

settings.server.uploadSpeedHelp.text: Din hjemmeinternets uploadhastighed. Streams uden for hjemmet deler cirka 80 % af den, og en ny stream afspiller i lavere kvalitet, når der er travlt.
settings.server.uploadSpeedHelp.source: Your home internet upload speed. Streams away from home share about 80% of it, and a new stream plays at a lower quality when it’s busy.

settings.server.windowsLede.text: Hvornår planlagte sikkerhedskopier kører. Andet baggrundsarbejde følger dit hastighedsvalg. Tiderne er serverens egne.
settings.server.windowsLede.source: When scheduled backups run. Other background work follows your speed choice. Times are the server’s own.

settings.signOutConfirm.bodyRemoving.text: Dine downloads fjernes fra denne enhed. Alt, du har downloadet, bliver på din server.
settings.signOutConfirm.bodyRemoving.source: Your downloads are removed from this device. Anything you downloaded stays on your server.

settings.signOutConfirm.bodyTV.text: Du skal logge dette TV ind igen.
settings.signOutConfirm.bodyTV.source: You’ll need to sign this TV in again.

settings.signOutConfirm.removeDownloads.text: Fjern mine downloads fra denne enhed
settings.signOutConfirm.removeDownloads.source: Remove my downloads from this device

settings.signOutConfirm.title.text: Vil du logge ud af {server} på denne {device}?

settings.signedInWithAccount.text: Logget ind på {server} med din Portico Account
settings.signedInWithAccount.source: Signed in to {server} with your Portico Account

settings.subtitlePreview.line.text: Sådan kommer undertekster til at se ud.
settings.subtitlePreview.line.source: This is how subtitles will look.

setup.app.connectLede.text: Din Portico Account åbner i browseren. Log ind der, hvis du har brug for det, godkend denne server, og kom derefter tilbage hertil.
setup.app.connectLede.source: Your Portico Account opens in the browser. Sign in there if you need to, approve this server, then come back here.

setup.app.found.text: Ingen har sat denne server op endnu. Du kan sætte den op herfra.
setup.app.found.source: Nobody has set up this server yet. You can set it up from here.

setup.app.nextWithAccount.text: Dernæst slutter denne server sig til {account} og får selv sin sikre forbindelse.
setup.app.nextWithAccount.source: Next, this server joins {account} and gets its secure connection by itself.

setup.app.notSetUp.text: Denne server er ikke sat op endnu. Sæt den op fra Portico-appen på en telefon eller tablet, eller åbn dens adresse i en browser.
setup.app.notSetUp.source: This server isn’t set up yet. Set it up from the Portico app on a phone or tablet, or open its address in a browser.

shell.titleNotOnProfile.text: Den titel er ikke længere tilgængelig på denne profil.
shell.titleNotOnProfile.source: That title isn’t available on this profile anymore.

signIn.chooseLocalProfile.text: Vælg en profil på denne server for at fortsætte.
signIn.chooseLocalProfile.source: Choose a profile on this server to continue.

signIn.cleanupSignedOut.text: Du er logget ud. Portico kunne ikke bekræfte, at den gemte login blev fjernet fra denne enhed.
signIn.cleanupSignedOut.source: You’re signed out. Portico couldn’t confirm that the saved sign-in was removed from this device.

signIn.cleanupUnconfirmed.text: Portico kunne ikke bekræfte, at den gemte login blev fjernet.
signIn.cleanupUnconfirmed.source: Portico couldn’t confirm that the saved sign-in was removed.

signIn.error.codeInvalid.text: Den kode virkede ikke. Kontrollér den, og prøv igen.
signIn.error.codeInvalid.source: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again.

signIn.error.detailsRequired.text: Indtast dine oplysninger for at logge ind.
signIn.error.detailsRequired.source: Enter your details to sign in.

signIn.error.expired.text: Det tog for lang tid. Start forfra.
signIn.error.expired.source: That took too long. Start again.

signIn.error.notAccepted.text: Den login blev ikke accepteret. Kontrollér dine oplysninger, og prøv igen.
signIn.error.notAccepted.source: That sign-in wasn’t accepted. Check your details and try again.

signIn.error.pinInvalid.text: Den PIN-kode er ikke korrekt. Prøv igen.
signIn.error.pinInvalid.source: That PIN isn’t right. Try again.

signIn.error.tooManyTries.text: For mange forsøg. Vent et øjeblik, og prøv derefter igen.
signIn.error.tooManyTries.source: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.

signIn.plainHttp.owner.text: Serverens ejer kan slå en sikker forbindelse til i Indstillinger › Fjernadgang.
signIn.plainHttp.owner.source: The server’s owner can turn on a secure connection in Settings › Remote access.

signIn.reset.body.text: Nulstil denne enhed for at logge ind igen.
signIn.reset.body.source: Reset this device to sign in again.

signIn.reset.consequence.text: Alle logges ud af Portico på denne enhed, og de servere og indstillinger, den husker, glemmes. Downloads bevares. Intet på din server ændres.
signIn.reset.consequence.source: Everyone is signed out of Portico on this device, and the servers and settings it remembers are forgotten. Downloads stay. Nothing on your server changes.

signIn.reset.failed.text: Denne enhed kunne ikke nulstilles. Prøv igen, eller ryd Porticos lager i denne enheds indstillinger.
signIn.reset.failed.source: This device couldn’t be reset. Try again, or clear Portico’s storage in this device’s settings.

signIn.reset.reopen.text: Luk Portico, og åbn det igen for at afslutte.
signIn.reset.reopen.source: Close Portico and open it again to finish.

signIn.reset.title.text: Denne enhed kan ikke læse sin gemte login
signIn.reset.title.source: This device can’t read its saved sign-in

signIn.savedUnreadable.text: Denne enhed kunne ikke læse sin gemte login. Log ind igen.
signIn.savedUnreadable.source: This device couldn’t read its saved sign-in. Sign in again.

signIn.unusedSession.text: Portico kunne ikke afslutte en ubrugt login. Den udløber af sig selv.
signIn.unusedSession.source: Portico couldn’t end an unused sign-in. It will expire on its own.

subtitles.error.changed.text: Underteksterne er ændret. Opdater, og gennemgå den aktuelle version, før du prøver igen.
subtitles.error.changed.source: Subtitles changed. Refresh and review the current revision before retrying.

subtitles.error.denied.text: Du har ikke længere adgang til disse undertekster.
subtitles.error.denied.source: You no longer have access to these subtitles.

subtitles.error.failed.text: Underteksterne kunne ikke opdateres. Opdater, eller prøv den samme handling igen.
subtitles.error.failed.source: Subtitles could not be updated. Refresh, or retry the same operation.

subtitles.error.invalidInput.text: Kontrollér sprog, fil og timing. Brug almindelige SRT/WebVTT eller understøttede avancerede/bitmap-undertekster inden for grænserne for størrelse og cues.
subtitles.error.invalidInput.source: Check the language, file and timing. Use plain SRT/WebVTT or supported rich/bitmap subtitles within the size and cue limits.

subtitles.error.missing.text: Denne undertekst er ikke længere tilgængelig. Opdater de aktuelle valgmuligheder.
subtitles.error.missing.source: This subtitle is no longer available. Refresh the current choices.

subtitles.error.providerBusy.text: OpenSubtitles er travlt. Prøv igen om et øjeblik.
subtitles.error.providerBusy.source: OpenSubtitles is busy. Try again in a moment.

subtitles.error.providerKeyRejected.text: OpenSubtitles accepterede ikke denne servers nøgle. Bed ejeren om at kontrollere den.
subtitles.error.providerKeyRejected.source: OpenSubtitles didn’t accept this server’s key. Ask the owner to check it.

subtitles.error.providerNotConfigured.text: Undertekstsøgning er ikke sat op på denne server. Bed ejeren om at tilføje en OpenSubtitles-nøgle.
subtitles.error.providerNotConfigured.source: Subtitle search isn’t set up on this server. Ask the owner to add an OpenSubtitles key.

subtitles.error.providerQuota.text: Denne server har brugt dagens OpenSubtitles-downloads. De starter igen kl. {time}.
subtitles.error.providerQuota.source: This server has used today’s OpenSubtitles downloads. They start again at {time}.

subtitles.error.providerQuotaLater.text: Denne server har brugt dagens OpenSubtitles-downloads. Prøv igen i morgen.
subtitles.error.providerQuotaLater.source: This server has used today’s OpenSubtitles downloads. Try again tomorrow.

subtitles.error.providerSignInFailed.text: OpenSubtitles accepterede ikke denne servers konto. Bed ejeren om at kontrollere den.
subtitles.error.providerSignInFailed.source: OpenSubtitles didn’t accept this server’s account. Ask the owner to check it.

subtitles.error.providerSignInRequired.text: OpenSubtitles tillader kun download fra konti, der er logget ind. Bed ejeren om at tilføje en konto.
subtitles.error.providerSignInRequired.source: OpenSubtitles only lets signed-in accounts download. Ask the owner to add an account.

title.changedElsewhere.text: Denne titel blev ændret på en anden enhed. Dit seneste valg bevares.
title.changedElsewhere.source: This title was changed on another device. Your latest choice is kept.

title.deleteVersion.body.text: Denne ene fil ({size}) slettes fra disken med det samme og kan ikke gendannes. Titlen, dens andre versioner og alles seerhistorik bevares. Hvis det er den eneste version, bliver titlen i biblioteket markeret som manglende.
title.deleteVersion.body.source: This one file ({size}) is deleted from disk at once and can’t be recovered. The title, its other versions and everyone’s watch history stay. If it is the only version, the title stays in the library marked missing.

title.fileUnavailable.text: Denne titels fil er ikke tilgængelig lige nu.
title.fileUnavailable.source: This title’s file isn’t available right now.

title.finishedCount.text: {finished, plural, one {# afsluttet} other {# afsluttede}} · {remaining, plural, one {# tilbage} other {# tilbage}}
title.finishedCount.source: {finished, plural, one {# finished} other {# finished}} · {remaining, plural, one {# remaining} other {# remaining}}

title.kind.text: {kind, select, movie {Film} show {TV-serie} anime {Anime} season {Sæson} episode {Episode} song {Sang} album {Album} artist {Kunstner} audiobook_file {Lydbog} book {Lydbog} collection {Samling} category {Kategori} author {Forfatter} book_series {Bogserie} disc {Disk} playlist {Spilleliste} person {Person} other {Titel}}
title.kind.source: {kind, select, movie {Movie} show {TV show} anime {Anime} season {Season} episode {Episode} song {Song} album {Album} artist {Artist} audiobook_file {Audiobook} book {Audiobook} collection {Collection} category {Category} author {Author} book_series {Book series} disc {Disc} playlist {Playlist} person {Person} other {Title}}

title.merge.action.text: Slå sammen med en anden titel…

title.missingSince.text: Dens filer har ikke været på disken siden {when}. Den kommer tilbage af sig selv med alt, som det var, når de vender tilbage.
title.missingSince.source: Its files have not been on disk since {when}. It comes back by itself, with everything as it was, when they return.

title.noCreditsBody.text: Intet på denne server krediterer denne person endnu.
title.noCreditsBody.source: Nothing on this server credits this person yet.

title.noEpisodesBody.text: Denne sæson har ingen episoder på serveren endnu.
title.noEpisodesBody.source: This season has no episodes on the server yet.

title.noRoleCredits.text: {role, select, cast {Ingen medvirkendekrediteringer på denne server.} crew {Ingen holdkrediteringer på denne server.} other {Ingen krediteringer på denne server.}}
title.noRoleCredits.source: {role, select, cast {No cast credits on this server.} crew {No crew credits on this server.} other {No credits on this server.}}

title.peopleFailed.text: Resten af de medvirkende og holdet kunne ikke indlæses.
title.peopleFailed.source: The rest of the cast and crew couldn’t be loaded.

title.playlistEmptyBody.text: Tryk og hold på en titel, og vælg Føj til spilleliste.
title.playlistEmptyBody.source: Press and hold a title and choose Add to playlist.

title.playlistEmptyBodyTV.text: Tryk og hold på Vælg på en titel, og vælg Føj til spilleliste.
title.playlistEmptyBodyTV.source: Press and hold Select on a title and choose Add to playlist.

title.separateArtist.body.text: For et album af en anden med samme navn. Albummet og dets sange flyttes til en ny kunstner med samme navn, og Portico slår ikke de to sammen igen af sig selv. Du kan omdøbe den nye kunstner eller slå dem sammen igen senere. Intet slettes.
title.separateArtist.body.source: For an album by someone else with the same name. The album and its songs move to a new artist of the same name, and Portico won’t join the two again by itself. You can rename the new artist, or merge them again later. Nothing is deleted.

title.separateArtist.failed.text: Albummet kunne ikke flyttes. En kunstners eneste album kan ikke skilles fra den.
title.separateArtist.failed.source: The album could not be moved. An artist’s only album can’t be separated from it.

title.separateArtist.title.text: Vil du flytte dette album til en kunstner for sig?
title.separateArtist.title.source: Move this album to an artist of its own?

title.showSettings.absolute.text: Nummerer episoder på tværs af sæsoner

title.showSettings.absoluteHelp.text: Episoder hedder ”Episode 1043” i stedet for en sæson og en episode.
title.showSettings.absoluteHelp.source: Episodes read “Episode 1043” instead of a season and an episode.

title.showSettings.hideSeasonsHelp.text: Én liste over episoder på tværs af alle sæsoner.
title.showSettings.hideSeasonsHelp.source: One list of episodes across every season.

title.showSettings.lede.text: Hvordan denne series episoder vises, for alle på denne server.
title.showSettings.lede.source: How this show’s episodes are listed, for everyone on this server.

title.showSettings.newestFirstHelp.text: For daglige serier: den nyeste episode er øverst.
title.showSettings.newestFirstHelp.source: For daily shows: the latest episode is at the top.

title.showSettings.rangesHelp.text: For lange serier: 1–100, 101–200 osv. i stedet for sæsoner.
title.showSettings.rangesHelp.source: For long shows: 1–100, 101–200 and so on, in place of seasons.

title.split.body.text: For en fil, der blev grupperet med den forkerte titel. Den bliver en titel for sig og matches igen. Intet slettes, og Portico husker valget, når den scanner. Du kan slå de to sammen igen senere.
title.split.body.source: For a file that was grouped with the wrong title. It becomes a title of its own and is matched again. Nothing is deleted, and Portico remembers the choice when it scans. You can merge the two again later.

title.split.failed.text: Versionen kunne ikke skilles fra. Prøv igen.
title.split.failed.source: The version could not be split off. Try again.

title.split.notFound.text: Portico kunne ikke finde denne fil på bibliotekets liste. Scan biblioteket, og prøv derefter igen.
title.split.notFound.source: Portico could not find this file in the library’s list. Scan the library, then try again.

title.split.title.text: Vil du gøre denne version til en titel for sig?
title.split.title.source: Make this version a title of its own?

title.splitFolder.body.text: For en mappe, der blev slået sammen med det forkerte album eller den forkerte bog. Alle filer i denne fils mappe flyttes til et album eller en bog for sig, og Portico slår dem ikke sammen igen af sig selv. Intet slettes, og du kan slå dem sammen igen senere.
title.splitFolder.body.source: For a folder that was joined with the wrong album or book. Every file in this file’s folder moves to an album or book of its own, and Portico won’t join them again by itself. Nothing is deleted, and you can merge them again later.

title.splitFolder.failed.text: Mappen kunne ikke adskilles. Prøv igen.
title.splitFolder.failed.source: The folder could not be separated. Try again.

title.splitFolder.title.text: Vil du gøre denne mappe til et album for sig?
title.splitFolder.title.source: Make this folder an album of its own?

title.splitFolder.titleBook.text: Vil du gøre denne mappe til en bog for sig?
title.splitFolder.titleBook.source: Make this folder a book of its own?

title.viewEmpty.text: Intet matcher denne visning lige nu
title.viewEmpty.source: Nothing matches this view right now

together.error.changed.text: Gruppen ændrede sig lige da. Prøv igen.
together.error.changed.source: The group changed just then. Try again.

together.error.memberCantSee.text: Nogen i gruppen kan ikke se denne titel på deres profil.
together.error.memberCantSee.source: Someone in the group can’t see this title on their profile.

together.error.notReached.text: Det nåede ikke gruppen. Prøv igen.
together.error.notReached.source: That didn’t reach the group. Try again.

together.error.queueAdd.text: Det kunne ikke tilføjes til gruppens kø.
together.error.queueAdd.source: That couldn’t be added to the group’s queue.

together.error.unavailable.text: Denne server tilbyder ikke Watch Together.
together.error.unavailable.source: This server doesn’t offer Watch Together.

together.hostOnly.move.text: Kun værten kan flytte gruppen til et andet tidspunkt.
together.hostOnly.move.source: Only the host can move the group to another moment.

together.hostOnly.playPause.text: Kun værten kan afspille og sætte på pause for gruppen.
together.hostOnly.playPause.source: Only the host can play and pause for the group.

twoFactor.verifyFailed.text: Den kode virkede ikke. Kontrollér den, og prøv igen.
twoFactor.verifyFailed.source: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again.

vega.connection.credentialExposed.text: Denne forbindelse sendte dine loginoplysninger til en anden adresse, så du er blevet logget ud.
vega.connection.credentialExposed.source: This connection sent your sign-in details to another address, so you have been signed out.

vega.connection.redirectLimit.text: Denne enhed kan først kontrollere omdirigeringer, når en anmodning er sendt.
vega.connection.redirectLimit.source: This device can check redirects only after a request has been sent.

watched.undoGone.text: Det er for sent at fortryde det. ”{title}” forbliver, som du markerede den.
watched.undoGone.source: It is too late to undo that. “{title}” stays as you marked it.

web.about.legal.text: Metadata og grafik leveres af TMDB og andre udbydere, der er konfigureret på din server.
web.about.legal.source: Metadata and artwork are provided by TMDB and other providers configured on your server.

web.about.tmdb.text: Dette produkt bruger TMDB API, men er ikke godkendt eller certificeret af TMDB.
web.about.tmdb.source: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

web.access.devicesLede.text: Alle enheder, der har logget ind på denne server.
web.access.devicesLede.source: Every device that has signed in to this server.

web.access.devicesWaiting.text: {count, plural, one {# enhed venter} other {# enheder venter}} på din godkendelse.
web.access.devicesWaiting.source: {count, plural, one {# device is} other {# devices are}} waiting for your approval.

web.access.emailHelp.text: Valgfri — bruges kun til at navngive invitationen.
web.access.emailHelp.source: Optional — only used to label the invitation.

web.access.invitationsLede.text: Lav et link og en kode at dele. De bliver medlem med deres Portico Account eller opretter en konto på denne server. Portico sender ingen mail.
web.access.invitationsLede.source: Make a link and a code to share. They join with their Portico Account, or make an account on this server. Portico sends no email.

web.access.keyNameHelp.text: Hvad der vil bruge denne nøgle.

web.access.keyShownOnce.text: Dette er den eneste gang, nøglen vises. Serveren gemmer et fingeraftryk, ikke nøglen.
web.access.keyShownOnce.source: This is the only time the key is shown. The server keeps a fingerprint, not the key.

web.access.remoteQualityHelp.text: Højeste bitrate, når du ikke er på dit hjemmenetværk, i Mbps.
web.access.remoteQualityHelp.source: Highest bitrate when not on your home network, in Mbps.

web.access.revokeBody.text: Alt, der bruger denne nøgle, holder op med at virke med det samme. Det kan ikke fortrydes.
web.access.revokeBody.source: Anything using this key stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

web.access.roleConfirmAdmin.text: {name} vil kunne administrere personer på denne server og se alle biblioteker.
web.access.roleConfirmAdmin.source: {name} will be able to manage people on this server and see every library.

web.access.roleConfirmMember.text: {name} bliver igen medlem med kun de biblioteker, der deles med dem.
web.access.roleConfirmMember.source: {name} will go back to being a member, with only the libraries shared with them.

web.access.sendTo.text: Send dette link til {email}. Det virker én gang og vises ikke igen.
web.access.sendTo.source: Send this link to {email}. It works once and is not shown again.

web.access.sendToAnyone.text: Send dette link til den, du inviterer. Det virker én gang og vises ikke igen.
web.access.sendToAnyone.source: Send this link to the person you’re inviting. It works once and is not shown again.

web.account.export.downloaded.text: Downloadet. Opbevar filen et privat sted.
web.account.export.downloaded.source: Downloaded. Keep the file somewhere private.

web.account.export.help.text: En kopi af dine Portico Account-data som JSON-fil.
web.account.export.help.source: A copy of your Portico Account data, as a JSON file.

web.account.export.preparing.text: Dine kontodata er stadig ved at blive forberedt. De vil være i Notifikationer, når de er klar.
web.account.export.preparing.source: Your account data is still being prepared. It will be in Notifications when it’s ready.

web.account.manageHostedBody.text: Adgangskode, loginmetoder, enheder, profiler og sikkerhed ligger på din Portico Account.
web.account.manageHostedBody.source: Password, sign-in methods, devices, profiles and security live on your Portico Account.

web.account.notif.emptyBody.text: Sikkerhedsændringer, nye logins og nyt om dine servere vises her.
web.account.notif.emptyBody.source: Security changes, new sign-ins and news about your servers appear here.

web.account.notif.joinedBody.text: En invitation, du sendte, blev accepteret.
web.account.notif.joinedBody.source: An invitation you sent was accepted.

web.account.notif.newDeviceBody.text: Hvis det ikke var dig, så log det ud og skift din adgangskode.
web.account.notif.newDeviceBody.source: If this wasn’t you, sign it out and change your password.

web.account.notif.prefServerOffline.text: En server, der er blevet stille
web.account.notif.prefServerOffline.source: A server that has gone quiet

web.account.notif.prefsHelp.text: Sikkerhedsændringer og nye logins vises altid.
web.account.notif.prefsHelp.source: Security changes and new sign-ins are always shown.

web.account.notif.securityBody.text: Hvis det ikke var dig, så gennemgå dine enheder og skift din adgangskode.
web.account.notif.securityBody.source: If it wasn’t you, review your devices and change your password.

web.account.notif.serverOfflineBody.text: Portico har ikke hørt fra denne server i et stykke tid. Kontrollér dens strøm og netværksforbindelse.
web.account.notif.serverOfflineBody.source: Portico hasn’t heard from this server for a while. Check its power and network connection.

web.account.notif.storageBody.text: Frigør plads, før du tilføjer flere medier.
web.account.notif.storageBody.source: Free up space before adding more media.

web.account.ownerResetsPassword.text: Hvis du glemmer din adgangskode, kan serverens ejer nulstille den.
web.account.ownerResetsPassword.source: If you forget your password, the server’s owner can reset it.

web.account.passwordChangedBody.text: Din nye adgangskode gælder fra nu af. Enheder, der allerede er logget ind, forbliver logget ind; log dem ud nedenfor, hvis du har brug for det.
web.account.passwordChangedBody.source: Your new password works from now on. Devices that are already signed in stay signed in; sign them out below if you need to.

web.account.passwordHelp.text: Bruges til at logge ind på denne server
web.account.passwordHelp.source: Used to sign in to this server

web.account.porticoMemberBody.text: Du logger ind på denne server med din Portico Account, så din adgangskode og totrinsbekræftelse administreres der. Profiler, PIN-koder og loggede enheder administreres her.
web.account.porticoMemberBody.source: You sign in to this server with your Portico Account, so your password and two-step verification are managed there. Profiles, PINs and signed-in devices are managed here.

web.account.profilesHelp.text: Hver profil har sin egen historik, Min liste og præferencer.
web.account.profilesHelp.source: Each profile keeps its own history, My List and preferences.

web.account.profilesHostedHelp.text: Hver profil har sin egen historik, Min liste og præferencer. Tilføj, omdøb og fjern dem i din Portico Account.
web.account.profilesHostedHelp.source: Each profile keeps its own history, My List and preferences. Add, rename and remove them in your Portico Account.

web.accountReturn.body.text: Vender tilbage til Portico-appen for at afslutte login.
web.accountReturn.body.source: Returning to the Portico app to finish signing in.

web.accountReturn.invalid.source: Start signing in again in the Portico app.

web.activity.noTasksBody.text: Scanninger, metadataopdateringer og vedligeholdelse vises her, mens de kører.
web.activity.noTasksBody.source: Scans, metadata refreshes and maintenance appear here as they run.

web.alerts.certificateWarningHelp.text: Dage i forvejen. Certifikater fornyer sig selv; dette udløses kun, hvis fornyelsen sidder fast.
web.alerts.certificateWarningHelp.source: Days ahead. Certificates renew by themselves; this only fires if renewal is stuck.

web.alerts.lede.text: Når serveren lægger en advarsel i dine notifikationer.
web.alerts.lede.source: When the server puts a warning in your notifications.

web.alerts.storageCriticalHelp.text: Optagelser og konverteringer kan begynde at fejle på dette tidspunkt
web.alerts.storageCriticalHelp.source: Recordings and conversions may start failing at this point

web.alerts.storageWarning.text: Advar, når ledig plads falder under
web.alerts.storageWarning.source: Warn when free space falls below

web.alerts.storageWarningHelp.text: Procentdel af et drev, der stadig er ledig
web.alerts.storageWarningHelp.source: Percent of a drive that is still free

web.broadcast.bodyTooLong.text: Beskeder kan højst være 1000 bytes; denne er {count} bytes.
web.broadcast.bodyTooLong.source: Messages can be at most 1000 bytes; this one is {count} bytes.

web.broadcast.lede.text: Vises i hver persons notifikationer. Det er ikke en mail.
web.broadcast.lede.source: Appears in each person’s notifications. It is not an email.

web.broadcast.titleExample.source: The server will be down on Saturday morning

web.broadcast.titleTooLong.text: Titler kan højst være 200 bytes; denne er {count} bytes.
web.broadcast.titleTooLong.source: Titles can be at most 200 bytes; this one is {count} bytes.

web.browser.unsupportedBody.text: Portico kræver Chrome eller Edge 111, Firefox 113, Safari 16.4 eller nyere. Opdater denne browser, eller åbn Portico i en anden.
web.browser.unsupportedBody.source: Portico needs Chrome or Edge 111, Firefox 113, Safari 16.4 or newer. Update this browser or open Portico in another one.

web.browser.unsupportedTitle.text: Denne browser er for gammel til Portico
web.browser.unsupportedTitle.source: This browser is too old for Portico

web.capabilities.help.text: Hvad denne server kan lige nu, og hvorfor ikke, når den ikke kan.
web.capabilities.help.source: What this server can do right now, and why not when it can’t.

web.capabilities.notChecked.text: Serveren har ikke kontrolleret dette endnu. Den gør det, når funktionen først bruges eller sættes op.
web.capabilities.notChecked.source: The server hasn’t checked this yet. It does when the feature is first used or set up.

web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxOf.text: Serverejeren har slået isolation af videoværktøjerne fra.
web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxOf.source: The server owner turned off isolation for the video tools.

web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxUn.text: Denne vært kan ikke isolere videoværktøjerne, så konverteringer kører med grundlæggende beskyttelse.
web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxUn.source: This host can’t isolate the video tools, so conversions run with baseline protections.

web.capabilities.reason.delivery.text: Kanalafspilning er ikke sat op på denne server.
web.capabilities.reason.delivery.source: Channel playback isn’t set up on this server.

web.capabilities.reason.dependencies.text: Videoværktøjerne er installeret, men nogle af de biblioteker, de skal bruge, kan ikke findes.
web.capabilities.reason.dependencies.source: The video tools are installed, but some of the libraries they need can’t be found.

web.capabilities.reason.dolbyVisionAppro.text: Denne server konverterer Dolby Vision med omtrentlige farver på skærme, der ikke kan vise det.
web.capabilities.reason.dolbyVisionAppro.source: This server converts Dolby Vision with approximate colors on screens that can’t show it.

web.capabilities.reason.hardware.text: Den hardwarekoder, du valgte, kan ikke bruges på denne server, så processoren bruges i stedet.
web.capabilities.reason.hardware.source: The hardware encoder you chose isn’t usable on this server, so the processor is used instead.

web.capabilities.reason.other.text: Portico kunne ikke slå dette til her. Tekniske oplysninger har årsagen.
web.capabilities.reason.other.source: Portico couldn’t turn this on here. Technical details has the cause.

web.capabilities.reason.platform.text: Denne servers operativsystem kan ikke isolere de videoværktøjer endnu, som Portico skal bruge til dette.
web.capabilities.reason.platform.source: This server’s operating system can’t isolate the video tools Portico needs for this yet.

web.capabilities.reason.tools.text: FFmpeg og ffprobe er ikke sat op på denne server.
web.capabilities.reason.tools.source: FFmpeg and ffprobe aren’t set up on this server.

web.cast.stopped.text: Stoppede med at afspille på TV’et.

web.channelBuilder.templatesFailed.text: Skabeloner kunne ikke indlæses. Prøv igen

web.channelProblem.general.text: Denne kanal kan ikke afspille lige nu. Prøv igen, eller vælg en anden kanal.
web.channelProblem.general.source: This channel can’t play right now. Try again, or pick another channel.

web.channelProblem.sourceUnavailable.text: Kanalens kilde svarer ikke. Prøv igen om et minut.
web.channelProblem.sourceUnavailable.source: The channel’s source isn’t responding. Try again in a minute.

web.channelProblem.stalled.text: Kanalen var for længe om at blive klar. Prøv igen.
web.channelProblem.stalled.source: The channel took too long to get ready. Try again.

web.channelProblem.startFailed.text: Serveren kunne ikke starte denne kanal. Prøv igen, eller vælg en anden kanal.
web.channelProblem.startFailed.source: The server couldn’t start this channel. Try again, or pick another channel.

web.channelProblem.storage.text: Serveren har ikke plads til at buffere live-TV lige nu. Ejeren kan frigøre plads i Server › Lager.
web.channelProblem.storage.source: The server has no room to buffer live TV right now. The owner can free up space in Server › Storage.

web.channelProblem.tunersBusy.text: Alle tunere optager eller er i brug. Prøv igen, når én bliver ledig.
web.channelProblem.tunersBusy.source: All tuners are busy recording or in use. Try again when one frees up.

web.chooser.accountWaitingBody.text: Portico Accounts svarer ikke lige nu. {server} er ikke berørt; Portico åbner den, så snart de er tilbage.
web.chooser.accountWaitingBody.source: Portico Accounts aren’t answering right now. {server} isn’t affected; Portico will open it as soon as they’re back.

web.chooser.lede.text: Vælg den server, der skal ses fra.
web.chooser.lede.source: Choose the server to watch from.

web.chooser.noneBody.text: Sæt en Portico-server op, og forbind den til denne konto, eller åbn en invitation fra en servers ejer.
web.chooser.noneBody.source: Set up a Portico server and connect it to this account, or open an invitation from a server’s owner.

web.chooser.signInDirectly.text: Log direkte ind på denne server
web.chooser.signInDirectly.source: Sign in directly to this server

web.chooser.unreachableBodyNever.text: Den har ikke været online endnu.

web.chooser.waitingBody.text: Portico opretter automatisk forbindelse, når den er tilbage.
web.chooser.waitingBody.source: Portico will connect automatically when it’s back.

web.claim.checkAddress.text: Godkend kun, hvis du startede dette fra din egen server, og adressen ovenfor er din.
web.claim.checkAddress.source: Approve only if you started this from your own server and the address above is yours.

web.claim.closed.text: Forbindelsen blev ikke godkendt. Du kan prøve igen.
web.claim.closed.source: The connection wasn’t approved. You can try again.

web.claim.connected.text: {server} er forbundet til din Portico Account. Den får sin sikre forbindelse nu og afslutter selv opsætningen.
web.claim.connected.source: {server} is connected to your Portico Account. It is getting its secure connection now and finishes setting up on its own.

web.claim.denied.text: Du afviste. {server} er ikke forbundet. Du kan lukke dette vindue.
web.claim.denied.source: You declined. {server} isn’t connected. You can close this window.

web.claim.errorInvalid.text: Den forbindelsesanmodning var ikke gyldig. Start igen fra serveren.
web.claim.errorInvalid.source: That connection request wasn’t valid. Start again from the server.

web.claim.errorStale.text: Den forbindelsesanmodning var allerede besvaret eller er udløbet. Start igen.
web.claim.errorStale.source: That connection request was already answered or has expired. Start again.

web.claim.errorTooMany.text: Denne server har allerede tre ventende forbindelsesanmodninger. Godkend eller afvis én, eller vent 10 minutter, til de udløber.
web.claim.errorTooMany.source: This server already has three connection requests waiting. Approve or deny one, or wait 10 minutes for them to expire.

web.claim.errorUnavailable.text: Denne server kan ikke forbindes lige nu. Prøv igen om et øjeblik.
web.claim.errorUnavailable.source: This server can’t be connected right now. Try again in a moment.

web.claim.expired.text: Denne forbindelsesanmodning er udløbet eller er allerede besvaret. Start igen fra serveren.
web.claim.expired.source: This connection request has expired or was already answered. Start again from the server.

web.claim.lede.text: Forbindelse lader folk logge ind med deres Portico Account, nå denne server uden for hjemmet og oprette sikker forbindelse til den. Serveren får sit certifikat af sig selv.
web.claim.lede.source: Connecting lets people sign in with their Portico Account, reach this server away from home and connect to it securely. The server gets its certificate by itself.

web.claim.notFound.text: Denne forbindelsesanmodning er ikke til din Portico Account, eller den findes ikke længere. Kontrollér, at du er logget ind på den rigtige konto, eller start igen fra serveren.
web.claim.notFound.source: This connection request isn’t for your Portico Account, or it no longer exists. Check you’re signed in to the right account, or start again from the server.

web.claim.openFromServer.text: Åbn denne side fra din server: dens førstegangsopsætning eller Indstillinger › Fjernadgang › Sikker forbindelse.
web.claim.openFromServer.source: Open this page from your server: its first-run setup, or Settings › Remote access › Secure connection.

web.claim.ownerProfileHelp.text: Den profil, der ejer serveren og kan administrere den.
web.claim.ownerProfileHelp.source: The profile that owns the server and can manage it.

web.claim.signInFirst.text: Log ind på den Portico Account, der skal eje denne server.
web.claim.signInFirst.source: Sign in to the Portico Account that will own this server.

web.claim.waiting.text: Godkend forbindelsen i Portico Account-vinduet. Denne side opdateres, når du gør det.
web.claim.waiting.source: Approve the connection in the Portico Account window. This page updates when you do.

web.connection.mismatchBody.text: Der svarer noget andet på adressen for {server}, så denne side er sat på pause. Portico forsøger fortsat at nå din server og bringer siden tilbage, når den svarer. Indstillinger, din konto og serverskift virker stadig.
web.connection.mismatchBody.source: Something else is answering at the address of {server}, so this page is paused. Portico keeps trying to reach your server and brings the page back when it answers. Settings, your account and switching servers still work.

web.connection.reconnectingBody.text: {server} svarer ikke lige nu. Portico bliver ved med at prøve og åbner den, så snart den opretter forbindelse igen. Indstillinger, din konto og serverskift virker stadig.
web.connection.reconnectingBody.source: {server} isn’t answering right now. Portico keeps trying and opens it as soon as it reconnects. Settings, your account and switching servers still work.

web.connection.replacedBody.text: Der svarer noget andet på adressen for {server}. Portico forsøger fortsat at nå din server. Hvis den er sat op igen fra bunden, skal du vælge ”Brug en anden konto eller server” og logge ind på den.
web.connection.replacedBody.source: Something else is answering at the address of {server}. Portico keeps trying to reach your server. If it was set up again from scratch, choose “Use another account or server” and sign in to it.

web.connectivity.customCertInvalid.text: Filerne er ikke et matchende PEM-certifikat og en nøgle.
web.connectivity.customCertInvalid.source: The files aren’t a matching PEM certificate and key.

web.connectivity.customCertMismatch.source: The certificate doesn’t cover this domain.

web.connectivity.customCertUnreadable.text: Certifikat- eller nøglefilen kan ikke læses. Kontrollér stierne, og at serveren kan læse dem.
web.connectivity.customCertUnreadable.source: The certificate or key file can’t be read. Check the paths and that the server can read them.

web.connectivity.discovery.source: Find this server on the home network

web.connectivity.httpOutsideHome.text: Denne forbindelse bruger HTTP uden for dine hjemmenetværk.
web.connectivity.httpOutsideHome.source: This connection uses HTTP outside your home networks.

web.connectivity.interfaceHelp.text: Hvilken netværksgrænseflade apps på dit hjemmenetværk bruger. Automatisk springer container- og virtuelle netværk over.

web.player.error.cannotPlay.source: This browser can’t play this title, and the server has no other way to send it. Another browser or one of the Portico apps may be able to.
